description: Wave 1. Add to BoundaryCondition<T> (fields/boundary/bc.rs) + wire the FV-operator boundary dispatch + polyMesh I/O round-trip: fixedGradient (non-zero Neumann), mixed (Robin: valueFraction blend of fixedValue+fixedGradient — also supplies the albedo/Robin BC flagged for neutronics), inletOutlet (fixedValue on inflow / zeroGradient on outflow by face-flux sign), outletInlet (opposite), slip (symmetry for vectors / zeroGradient for scalars), noSlip (fixedValue 0 vector), wedge (axisymmetric). Cite OpenFOAM class names (inletOutletFvPatchField, mixedFvPatchField, slipFvPatchField, wedgeFvPatchField, ...). V&V: mixed reduces to fixedValue (frac=1) and fixedGradient (frac=0) limits + a Robin analytic case; inletOutlet switches correctly with flux sign; slip zeroes the normal component; conservation. Single agent (shared enum). Untrusted AI-assisted draft pending human V&V.
title: outram-foam-basic-lib: patch-field BC family — fixedGradient, mixed(Robin), inletOutlet, outletInlet, slip, noSlip, wedge
